spl_unclassified_section: Other information Store at room temperature 15-30 (59-86°F)
active_ingredient: Active ingredient Isopropyl Alcohol, 70% v/v Purpose Antiseptic
indications_and_usage: Use For preparation of skin prior to injection
warnings: Warnings For external use only. Flammable, keep away from fire or flame. Do not use with electrocautery procedures in the eyes on mucous membranes on irritated skin. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or redness develops. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control center right away.
do_not_use: Do not use with electrocautery procedures in the eyes on mucous membranes on irritated skin.
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or redness develops.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions Wipe injection site vigorously and discard.
